title: 第6章 豪门千金（6）-《反派BOSS有毒》
content:
第(1/3)页

    用餐期间楚棠并未说话，姿势高贵，动作优雅，看他吃饭都是一种享受。

    美人当前，时笙食欲都好了许多，撑得肚子鼓鼓的。

    楚棠看着时笙摸自己肚子的小动作，嘴角不免又弯了几分，“我很好奇，许总是亏待了许小姐吗？”

    时笙动作一顿，他这是说她吃得多吗？

    “看到楚先生，食欲难免会增加。”时笙回以浅笑。

    楚棠愣了下，他这是……被调戏了？

    两个小时前这丫头见自己还是一副自己会吃了她的模样，两个小时后竟然敢调戏他了，胆子倒是不小。

    吃饱喝足后，时笙的胆子确实大了不少。

    哦，不对，她的胆子向来大，只是一开始她有些不适应和楚棠相处。就像是一杯热饮和一杯冷饮，两者结合，是需要一定时间缓冲的。

    “楚先生晚上有约吗？”

    “怎么，许小姐想约我？”楚棠低笑了一声，“我的出场费很贵的，许小姐确定付得起吗？”

    “付不起我可以肉偿。”

    撩汉技能本宝宝早就点爆了，小样！

    “肉偿就不必了，给许小姐算个优惠价，一百万。”楚棠指尖搭在桌面上，轻轻的敲了几下，摆着‘付完钱，今晚大爷就是你的’范儿。

    两人沉默了几秒，时笙不确定的问，“你不会真的要我钱吧？”

    楚棠扬着下巴矜贵的点了点头。

    时笙：“……”

    呵呵，来人啊，给这个变态给本宝宝拖出去！

    时笙思索了片刻，从包里掏出许父让她随便开的支票，唰唰的给楚棠开了一千万，‘啪’的一声拍在楚棠面前，灰常豪气的道：“我包你十天！”

    楚棠修长的指尖夹着薄薄的支票，看着上面隽秀的字，眼底闪过一缕邪气，“许小姐为了我一掷千金，哪有拒绝的道理。”

    说完楚棠就将支票放到了他裤兜里，起身，绅士的朝着时笙伸出手，“许小姐，接下来十天我就是你的，陪吃陪喝……陪睡，都没问题。”

    时笙嘴角抽搐了下，不知为何感觉自己接下来会大出血。

    她竟然把楚棠给包了……想想还是蛮兴奋的。

    时笙将手放到楚棠手中，他的手有些凉，却很干燥，她的手放上去，还蛮搭的。

    两人往门口走去，快到门口的时候，被人给拦住了。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Chu Tang didn’t speak during the meal. His posture was noble and his movements were elegant. It was a pleasure to watch him eat.

With the beauty in front of her, Shi Sheng's appetite has improved a lot, and his belly is bulging.

Chu Tang looked at Shi Sheng's small movements of touching her belly, and the corners of her mouth couldn't help but curve a little more, "I'm very curious, did Mr. Xu treat Miss Xu badly?"

Shi Sheng made a move. Did he mean that she ate too much?

"When I see Mr. Chu, my appetite will inevitably increase." Shi Sheng smiled back.

Chu Tang was stunned for a moment. Was he... being teased?

“ Two hours ago, this girl saw that she was still looking like he would eat her. Two hours later, she dared to tease him. She was quite courageous.

After eating and drinking, Shi Sheng became more courageous indeed.

Oh, no, she has always been bold, but she was a little uncomfortable getting along with Chu Tang at first.Just like a hot drink and a cold drink, the combination of the two requires a certain amount of time to buffer.

"Mr. Chu, do you have an appointment tonight?"

"What, Miss Xu wants to date me?" Chu Tang chuckled, "My appearance fee is very expensive, are you sure Miss Xu can afford it?"

"If I can't afford it, I can pay with my body."

This baby’s Flirting Skill has been used up for a long time, demo!

"There's no need to pay in flesh. Let's give Miss Xu a preferential price of one million." Chu Tang put his fingertips on the table, tapped it a few times, and said, "After paying the money, I will be yours tonight."

The two were silent for a few seconds, and Shi Sheng asked uncertainly, "You don't really want my money, do you?"

Chu Tang raised his chin and nodded solemnly.

Shi Sheng: "..."

Hehe, come on, drag this pervert out of here!

Shi Sheng thought for a moment, then took out the check Xu's father asked her to write out from her bag, and wrote 10 million to Chu Tang. She slapped it in front of Chu Tang with a 'pop' sound, and said with great pride: "I'll guarantee you ten days!"

Chu Tang held the thin check between his slender fingertips and looked at the elegant words on it. A ray of evil flashed in his eyes, "Miss Xu spent a lot of money for me, there is no reason to refuse."

After saying that, Chu Tang put the check in his trouser pocket, stood up, and stretched out his hand towards Shi Sheng like a gentleman, "Miss Xu, I will be yours for the next ten days. I will eat, drink, and sleep with you, no problem."

The corner of Shi Sheng's mouth twitched, and for some reason he felt that he would bleed heavily next.

She actually got Chu Tang under her wing... I'm quite excited when I think about it.

Shi Sheng put his hand on Chu Tang's. His hand was a little cold, but very dry. Her hand was quite suitable when she put it on it.

The two of them walked towards the door. When they were approaching the door, they were stopped by someone.
